preregistration_note: Written and committed before the cascade code was run. The expected outcomes follow from standard linear ODE theory; this is a STANDARD-PROPERTY CHECK, not a new architecture and not a discovery.
question: In a two-layer linear cascade driven by the same piecewise-constant external input, does a layerwise computation that holds layer 1's endpoint value (ZOH) as the input of layer 2 change when the held input interval is split, although the coupled continuous-time solution does not?

system.outputs: h1, h2 at the common base times
system.equal_case_note: a=c makes the 2x2 generator a Jordan block (t*exp(-a t) term); the closed form uses phi1((c-a)*tau), which is continuous at a=c

input.external_input: right-held piecewise-constant path of FIRST_RUN unit seed 0 on the FIRST_RUN uniform base grid (T=8, K=16); no new seed, no new grid family
input.splitting: every base interval split into m equal sub-intervals, each sub-step repeating the held base value (physical time and original input preserved)

computations.coupled_exact: closed-form flow of the 2x2 linear system over each held sub-interval
computations.coupled_rk4: independent classical RK4 on the coupled system with the held input, 4096 sub-steps per base interval
computations.layerwise: layer 1: exact ZOH of the held external input; layer 2: exact ZOH whose input on (s_{j-1}, s_j] is held at the layer-1 endpoint value h1(s_j) (right-endpoint convention, as in the FIRST_RUN recurrences)

metrics.slope: least-squares log-log slope of layerwise_error over m in {1,2,4,8}

hypotheses.COMP-H1: coupled_invariance <= 1e-12 for m in {2,4,8}, both cases (engineering check of flow composition)
hypotheses.COMP-H2: coupled_vs_rk4 <= 1e-9 for all m, both cases (engineering check)
hypotheses.COMP-H3: layer1_identity <= 1e-12 for all m, both cases
hypotheses.COMP-H4: layerwise_error slope in [-1.2, -0.8], both cases (first-order inter-layer hold error)
hypotheses.COMP-H5: layerwise_error at m=1 >= 1e-3, both cases (the inter-layer hold error is not negligible at the base step)

interpretation_rule: Any layerwise change across m is a change of the inter-layer reconstruction of an INTERNAL signal. No external observation is added; it must not be called new information.

stop_conditions.S1_bug: If COMP-H1 or COMP-H2 fails, treat it as an implementation bug; do not interpret.
stop_conditions.S3_no_sweep: No additional parameter, seed or grid values.
